magento-open-source.notes: White-box source pass on magento2 2.4-develop @7a5b09b9 (magento/magento2ce). Fresh-code trust boundaries reviewed (all GraphQL mutations, anonymous webapi ACL, deserialization, SSRF, SQLi/XXE, upload validators). Customer-owned authorization is robust. One sub-floor seed handed to helios: estimateShippingMethods (QuoteGraphQl) omits the GetCartForUser object-level check that its sibling estimateTotals enforces (CWE-639), but it is gated by a secret 32-char CSPRNG masked cart id and returns only non-PII shipping rates. Runtime repro not possible in clean lane (no MySQL). See audits/magento-open-source-2.4-develop.md.
